description: Sentinel-2 10-Meter Land Use/Land Cover Time Series is a dataset listed in FEMA Disaster Resilience Hub, a disaster resilience data hub, published or maintained by Esri. This web map displays the land use/land cover (LULC) timeseries layer derived from ESA Sentinel-2 imagery at 10m resolution. The visualization uses blend modes and is best used in the new Map Viewer. The time slider can be used to advance through the five years of data from 2017-2021. Coverage: United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Esri. Its keywords are Land Cover, Microsoft, Impact Observatory, land use, global, world, sentinel. The bounding box given is 92.0151,26.3420,92.4198,26.5227. The hub shows 2026-01-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fema-resilience-hub.
